div.head: Norðleoda 8
div.ab: 7 gif he ænig land næbbe 7 þeh freoh sy, forgylde man hine mid LXX scll'.
Et si nichil terre habeat et liber tamen sit, reddatur LX sol. et decem sol.
And gif he ænig land næbbe 7 þeah freoh sy, forgilde hine man mid LXX scill'.
And gif he ænig land næbbe and þeh freo sy, forgylde man hine mid LXX scillinga.
Und wenn er kein Land besitzt und (aber Ld) doch frei ist, werde er [wenn erschlagen] entgolten mit 70 Schill.
And if he has no land and (but, Ld) is nevertheless free, let him [if slain] be paid for with 70 shillings.
And if he has no land and nevertheless is free, one is to pay for him with 70 shillings.
And if he does not have any land but is still free, then compensation for him shall be seventy shillings.
div.note: Ine 32 has LX. Liebermann compares Ine 32.
